comparison.objective: Slide a slab from a free-wheeled rover to the ground without lifting it or moving the rover; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Reaction-aware sliding of a large load while stabilizing a mobile base versus fine coaxial tool placement, bimanual striking, impact regulation, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Remove the slab without lifting it and keep the rover stationary versus complete four safe physical fractures and contain all released tangs.
comparison.reason: The tasks share force control only at a generic level; large-object sliding and base stabilization do not test precision fracture. The record is sparse, with no numeric rover-motion threshold or specs.
